title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Free-Boundary Partial Differential Equations
summary: We study free-boundary problems within a physics-informed framework using Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN) approximations. The proposed approach incorporates obstacle constraints, partial differential equation (PDE) inequalities, complementarity conditions, and boundary conditions through residual-based loss functions. We consider a linear elliptic obstacle problem, a nonlinear $p$-Laplacian obstacle problem, and a time-dependent one-phase Stefan problem.
